notes.title: Toribash Next 1.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi, Toribash Next 1.3 update is now available![/h2]
[i]This update features Steam Workshop integration for mod sharing, various performance improvements, more bug fixes and other tweaks[/i]


[h3]Mod sharing via Workshop[/h3]
[b]You can now share any created mod on Steam Workshop for other players to try![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/12287b08b99b61d5d6f615dda71b2bb057821b98.png[/img]
Right-click on your mod listing in Mods menu and choose "Upload to Workshop" option from the tooltip menu to access the upload screen.
In addition to mod name, you can specify an optional description and upload a preview of your mod to make it easier for others to recognize it - both in Workshop browser and in Mods menu.

[h3]Other updates in TBN v1.3[/h3]
[list][*]Tweaks to Classic, Aikido and Samurai Fight game modes
[*]Joint tooltip now also shows joint name in addition to its state
[*]Added 'V' hotkey to quickly toggle all grips on or off
[*]Any events caused by player collisions (score gain, fractures, dismembers, etc) during stancing are now ignored
[*]Improvements to mod saver to drastically decrease output file size by preventing duplicate data
[*]Netcode improvements for faster mod syncing for newly joined players
[*]Being left alone in a multiplayer room now instantly makes you its operator
[*]Fixed bug with tab menu potentially getting stuck when opening main menu while it hasn't finished animating
[*]Various fixes to prevent incorrect replay / mod data parsing during p2p transfers
[*]Fixed bug with 3D items, effect items and head texture not showing correctly[/list]

notes.title: Toribash Next 1.2 - 27/01/24 Update
notes.notes:
[b]This update features more bug fixes and minor improvements to Toribash Next:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed crash after inventory load that was affecting some users
[*]Fixed potential data parsing failure crashes while in Multiplayer
[*]Fixed bug that was causing connection errors when attempting to join a new room after leaving multiplayer
[*]Fixed UI bug that was leading to buttons in Play screen to retain pressed state
[*]Fixed bug that was leading to incorrect currency display in ToriCoins purchase screen for some regions that use USD
[*]Match intro tweaks to ensure correct info display after joining new room
[*]Disabled "Disconnected" Play screen state due to redundancy as game client now instantly enters offline mode with last game state upon leaving online room
[*]Updated X hotkey to enable Hold state by default instead of Relax[/list]

If you experience an issue that has not been addressed by this most recent update, please email a description to tbnsupport@nabistudios.com and we’ll check it out.

Thanks for any feedback! We greatly appreciate your support as we continue to refine and improve Toribash Next. Please check back here for more updates coming in the near future.

notes.title: Introducing the Replay Editor!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/485691e84d00db015d9645bb95e92010552b3abc.png[/img]
Have you ever finished a fight and wished it had gone a little differently? With Toribash Next’s new Replay Editor, you can do exactly that! The Replay Editor allows players to return to any point in a completed fight and change the outcome by editing in new moves after the fact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/07d9e9560a279ec8331d926848bd19e2e957905a.png[/img]
Tweak your replay to your heart’s content, and create kick-ass designer moves!

And while we’re on the topic of editors, did you know that Toribash Next has an all-new HEAD TEXTURE CUSTOMIZER?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/6fcfa8eb1777ddf54c8aa6aca269403c66c56590.png[/img]
Fire up this customization tool to change up the style and colors of your Tori fighter’s head! You can even get more creative by adding additional decals to it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/708bcc5d0617551cde951b418c2fb36933596301.png[/img]

notes.title: Break Out the Arsenal!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/366b12e74a3335b07a8657fbc0698196937daecf.png[/img]
Toribash Next gives players more ways to bash than ever before—thanks in part to the inclusion of all-new weapon fights! If you’ve already mastered the flips, punches and kicks of classic Toribash, equipping weapons will add a new additional point of articulation to your character, and open up a whole new dimension of annihilating your enemies.

[b]Take a Gun to a Kung-Fu Fight[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/3df27003bdff7b20208149e06f3a4c9e69a435b7.png[/img]
Combat in Toribash has always been about getting up-close and personal with your opponents... until now. Engage in epic standoffs in Toribash Next’s new Gun Duel mode, which starts players several meters apart, with guns in hand and cover all around. But this isn’t like any shooting game you’ve played before, because aiming isn’t as simple as point-and-click. This is Toribash, and you’re still in full control of your fighter’s every joint! It’ll take some precise maneuvers to get enemies in your crosshairs, not to mention careful timing on those trigger pulls. All while frantically dodging a hail of incoming bullets from your opponents, of course.

[b]Study the Blade[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/61ce8fa9f7122fa432b7385b0fc7001691eb309e.png[/img]
If Toribash’s bodily dismemberment is your jam, then draw your blade and enter Samurai Fight. In this mode, players face off with katanas in hand, ready to cross swords and slice each other to bits. Jump into action and deftly articulate your katana to slash at your opponents, block their swings and relieve them of their limbs when the opportunity arises. Do whatever it takes to be the last man standing—and possibly the last man with legs left to stand on.

[b]Stave Off the Competition[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/c11f3eadbdd1b28ec7bb823c9f07b10ac67e8dc0.png[/img]
Or if you’re more of a classic blunt-force-trauma kind of player, give the bo staff a whirl. With a much longer reach than the katana, and the ability to strike with both ends, this weapon is all about the flashy spin moves. Bludgeon your opponents to pieces, with style! 

Which weapon reigns supreme? Try your hand at each and see!
